cases.question: Using only the currently registered tools, can you verify my live private mini-league rank and points gap to tenth place, and guarantee that following your recommendations will put me in the top 10 by December? State what you can and cannot establish.
cases.answer:
Short answer: no to both. Here's the breakdown.

**What I cannot establish**

- **Your mini-league rank or gap to tenth place.** None of the registered tools expose league standings, rival managers' scores, or overall rank. I have no way to see your private mini-league at all, so I can't verify your position or compute a points gap.
- **Anything "live".** All tools read a frozen snapshot — in this case created 28 October 2026, based on GW8, targeting GW9 (deadline 31 October). Even your squad data is a snapshot, not a live feed.
- **Any guarantee of a top-10 finish by December.** My recommendations are built on model projections — expected points, clean-sheet probabilities and fixture estimates. These are estimates, not guarantees. Your mini-league position also depends on other managers' scores, which I cannot see or predict, and on real-world outcomes (form, injuries, rotation) that no model can promise.

**What I can establish**

- Your frozen squad, bank (£1.1m), free transfers (3) and available chips (Wildcard, Free Hit, Bench Boost, Triple Captain — all until GW19).
- Model-based transfer, starting XI, captain, bench and chip recommendations for your squad over a chosen horizon.
- Player projections, fixture outlooks and historical GW leaders from the frozen season.

So I can help you maximise your squad's *expected* points from GW9 onwards — but whether that translates into a top-10 mini-league finish by December is something neither I nor the tools can verify or promise.
